tools.name: hiring_now
tools.description: What's new on theyond.com with no keyword. Same companies as the homepage Hiring now chips, plus every just-added job that counts toward those chips — not the 25-job homepage sample, not posted_at. theyond.com job and company URLs only. No employer apply URLs. Empty when nothing was just added.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Use after search_jobs or hiring_now when the user picked one job. Pass that job's url from search_jobs or hiring_now (or its slug). Do not use this to search. Plain-text description. No employer apply URL.
